scenario.intro: Build a "what if" event (e.g. a magnitude 6.5 earthquake at a given point) and see how many people and how much infrastructure would be exposed — nothing here is a real, ongoing event.
scenario.name: Scenario Name
scenario.hazardTypeHint: Only hazard types with a simulation formula produce a result. Right now that's just Earthquake — other types are marked "not simulated yet" below.
scenario.magnitudeHint: Richter scale value for the hypothetical earthquake.
scenario.epicenterHint: Decimal degrees — e.g. 41.0082 / 28.9784 for Istanbul. Click the map to look up coordinates if unsure.
scenario.datasetsHint: Tick at least one population dataset (e.g. "kontur" or "worldpop") to calculate how many people would be affected.
scenario.noDatasets: No exposure datasets available — upload one first.
scenario.resultHint: "Total exposed value" is the sum of the dataset's metric inside the simulated area — for a population dataset, that's the estimated number of people affected.
scenario.rangeWarning: These parameters are outside the formula's validated range — treat this estimate with caution.
scenario.noFormulaAvailable: Scenario simulation is not yet available for hazard type "{hazardType}".

errors.simulationFailed: The simulation could not be completed.

cascadeRules.intro: Define when a primary hazard event should elevate a secondary risk — e.g. an earthquake near a river triggering an elevated flood-risk assessment. Every condition below is deterministic and admin-configured; no AI/ML is used anywhere in evaluating these rules.
cascadeRules.triggerHazardTypeHint: Use "any" for a rule that should be checked regardless of hazard type (e.g. a vulnerability-based rule).
cascadeRules.minVulnerabilityScoreHint: Reuses the area's Vulnerability factor from Risk & Scenario Modeling — requires Vulnerability indicators to be configured for the area.
cascadeRules.recommendationTemplatePlaceholder: e.g. [[area]]: elevated flood risk from a magnitude [[magnitude]] event [[distance_km]]km from the river. Estimated [[affected_population]] people in the area.
cascadeRules.recommendationTemplateHint: Available placeholders: [[area]], [[magnitude]], [[distance_km]], [[vulnerability_score]], [[affected_population]]. Plain substitution only — no generated text.

errors.noCondition: At least one condition (magnitude threshold, proximity layer, or vulnerability threshold) must be set.

cascadeAuto.title: Automatic Cascade Evaluation (opt-in)
cascadeAuto.intro: When enabled, new real hazard events in this country are automatically checked against your cascade rules — no manual "Evaluate" click needed. This never creates a CAP alert, dispatch, or external notification of any kind; it only shows up here as an item to review. Only country_admin can turn this on or off. Off by default.
